rcrg-01-c1.quote: Anthropologists briskly adopted, but did not invent, the term 'cargo cult'.
rcrg-01-c1.claim: Anthropologists didn't coin the term, but within a few years some of them, including Lucy Mair and Ian Hogbin, had taken it up.
